purpose: Teach: 冬季/転換期/引き揚げ/大出/炎上/踏み切っ/杏/撒き

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、冬季、絶対、特有の、絶対、事件、絶対、警察、絶対、対応中です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're currently handling this case with full seriousness. It's a winter-season specific incident, and I appreciate your attention to it.
lines.style: Steady, measured official tone. Even pace, professional distance. Brief pause between case summary and gratitude. Eyes level, jaw relaxed.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 業界の、本気で、絶対、転換期、絶対、警察の取り組みも、絶対、変わってきていますか、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Has the police approach itself changed during this transition period in the industry?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity, not challenging. Leans in slightly. Soft attack on the opening word. Pace deliberate — he's thinking as he speaks. Slight rising inflection at the question mark.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。証拠の、本気で、絶対、引き揚げ、絶対、慎重に、絶対、警察、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're proceeding carefully with evidence recovery. It's methodical work.
lines.style: Formal procedural delivery. Clipped, confident. No rush. Emphasise 「慎重に」 with quiet weight — this is the important part. Trail off slightly on the final phrase.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 昨年の、本気で、絶対、大出火、絶対、捜査、絶対、結果、絶対、出ましたか、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Did the investigation into last year's major fire yield any results?
lines.style: Reflective, almost drifting. Slower pace than Ren's usual speech. Looking inward as well as outward. Slight hesitation before the question, as if pulling up memory.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。SNSの、本気で、絶対、炎上、絶対、絡みの、絶対、事件、絶対、警察、絶対、増えております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've seen an increase in incidents connected to social media incidents — cases where online escalation becomes criminal activity.
lines.style: Procedural, slightly weary. Measured delivery. No judgment, just fact. Small pause before the summary statement. Shoulders settle slightly as he delivers this.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 容疑者、本気で、絶対、自首に、絶対、踏み切った、絶対、と聞きました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I heard the suspect turned themselves in.
lines.style: Careful, testing the ground. Slower attack on the opening word. Soft, almost uncertain — he's checking if he has the fact right. Slight lift at the end, waiting for confirmation.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。被害者の、本気で、絶対、杏、絶対、子さん、絶対、警察、絶対、聴取、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're conducting interviews with the victim now, Anzu. The process is ongoing.
lines.style: Official, respectful tone. Slight warmth on the victim's name — acknowledging her personhood within procedure. Even pace. Closing statement is matter-of-fact, not cold.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 種撒き、本気で、絶対、を装った、絶対、薬物密売、絶対、警察、絶対、注視されているそうですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I understand the police are watching closely for drug trafficking operations disguised as seed distribution.
lines.style: Serious, edge of alarm just beneath. Deliberate, almost heavy pace. Quiet intensity on 「種撒き」 — he knows what's being hidden. Trailing-off at the very end, as if there's more unsaid.
